correctness.rationale: The rows/columns range independently over all 1820 four-subsets of the cyclic group. Twenty-five affine row orbits partition all row sets, and exact cyclotomic determinant tests together with a mathematically justified characteristic-97 method agree for each of 45,500 orbit-representative pairs. The eight-root test is equivalent to complex vanishing because every reduced minor coefficient has absolute value at most 24<97, and the reduction has degree at most 7. Exact pair-by-pair program replay confirms rank counts (16,9728,293888,3008768); proof reduces all 3,312,400 cases.

value.rationale: The standard 16-point cyclic Fourier transform is a canonical dyadic Fourier example with 1820 natural four-frequency row restrictions. A complete census of rank losses (1,2,3,4) and the 25 affine row geometries gives precise interpolation nullities beyond all-or-nothing full spark and reveals a large difference from the elementary abelian Fourier transform of the same order. It is a motivated self-contained finite classification, not an arbitrary low-dimensional slice or routine substitution; no larger theorem is asserted.
